exclusions.reason: The current 2026 official guide exposes only Chinese Language and International Business master's offerings, both already present in the formal catalog; no semantic duplicate program was emitted. A distinct provincial scholarship identity was retained.

No accessible official 2026 international-admission page proving an additional personally applicable program was found. Domestic medical catalogs and third-party pages were excluded; the existing Clinical Medicine record is not duplicated.

No current official international-student admission guide with a personally applicable additional program was found. A 2025 work-plan page about drafting admissions was not treated as a program source; the existing Tibetan Language record is not duplicated.
Domestic-student catalogs, discipline authorization lists, department pages without explicit international eligibility, non-official aggregators and inferred dates or fees were not used as facts.

notes: Thirty-four cross-pack-deduplicated international-student program candidates and fourteen scholarship candidates were added across thirteen assigned institutions.

Verified open cycles as of 2026-08-03 include SCAU's Guangdong Government scholarship (deadline 2026-09-01) and CCNU International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship non-degree routes (deadlines 2026-09-15 and 2026-10-31).
All expired cycles are explicitly closed and must never be surfaced as currently open.
AHU and JUFE live program identities are retained at quality tier B because their currently accessible catalogs do not publish a fully dated 2026 cycle for every program.
Hainan Medical University and Tibet University were not padded with domestic or third-party records; their existing formal records remain unduplicated.
All program-scholarship references resolve only to candidate IDs inside this package, and every source URL is official HTTPS.
